hook: Your whole city trip here happens with zero cars.
title: Your city trip has zero cars
description:
Venice's historic centre has no roads for cars. Canals work as the streets, and people travel by boat or on foot. Buses, taxis and ambulances are all boats.

#Shorts #Venice #Geography
